- Build a complete, playable comedic anime-inspired visual novel featuring Kimi, beach and hot springs chapters, and three endings.

## Requirements
- User requested AI-generated anime stills, a Naruto-inspired art style, common mishap tropes, a neutral ending, a married ending, and a tragic death ending.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them when finishing.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Kimi is the protagonist’s nineteen-year-old younger sister; romance is redirected to Emi, an unrelated adult childhood friend.
- Illustrations are original, locally generated SVG scenes rather than external AI-generated images.
- The tragic ending is a fictional, non-graphic accident.

### Completed
- Added title screen, visual styling, responsive layout, dialogue UI, menu, and save/continue controls.

- Test game playability and responsive layout; capture and inspect the latest JPEG screenshot.

1. Inspect and repair `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`, including choice routing to all three endings.
2. Run a syntax check and launch the game in a browser; test key story paths, save/resume, and mobile layout.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; report the SVG-vs-AI-art assumption clearly.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: story data, SVG illustration generation, UI behavior; currently needs repair.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: game markup and title screen.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: visual design and responsive styles.

## Important Context
- Current story has adult protagonist/characters; romantic ending is with Emi, not Kimi.
- Game artwork is original SVG, not AI-generated or Naruto-style.
